title: Epsilon Edu — English 3 Explore
description: Khám phá Tiếng Anh 3 Global Success: riêng Mục 6–9 theo 4 Level. Mục 10 trong kham_pha_tieng_anh_3_muc_10.json.

language_policy.display_rule: English first; Vietnamese support below when appropriate.

content_audit.source: SGK Tiếng Anh 3 Global Success Tập 1 + Tập 2 (20 Units), SBT Global Success 3 (Unit exercises)
content_audit.policy: Part 2 contains only M6–M9: four Unit-based Levels, 50 questions each. Grammar M10 moved into independent JSON without Levels.
content_audit.question_policy: Each topic/level has 50 questions: exactly 10 questions from each of its five Units; distractors and explanations are separate from each correct answer.
content_audit.sgk_crosscheck: Syllabus themes/structures drawn from the book maps (SGK Tập 1 pp.4–5, Tập 2 pp.4–5) and corresponding lesson pages; original stories/dialogues are new pedagogical exercises, not direct SGK passages.
content_audit.images: No new catalog-bound images introduced. Where pictured, existing emoji fallback is used; no imagined image catalog IDs.
content_audit.excluded: M1–M5, M6–M9 questions, account, lesson/exam modules, GAS unchanged.
content_audit.test_status: Source/schema/content audit required. Browser/PWA/live TTS not yet independently confirmed.

reading_pairs_class2_ui.mode: 25 two-question reading passages per Level; 100 passages/200 questions
reading_pairs_class2_ui.translation_reveal: only after both answers in a passage are correct

runtime_role: Explore Part 2: sections 6–9 only; grammar section 10 is in separate file
